g.text: Median and full observed range across batches within each run
Measured probe elapsedNanos; recorder overhead included where active. Single host, no controlled speedup claim.
512 cubes per generation/load batch; 1M resident lookups per batch. Saves cover current world dirty work; pending counts vary.
Batches use different coordinates and JIT/cache state; range is descriptive, not a confidence interval.
